name: Operational-risk relative switch
hypothesis: Buy the independently cleared, liquid token only after relative-strength confirmation; hedge with an authorized broad instrument if specified.
spec: Setup: Similar tokens may differ in restored execution quality after an incident. Entry: Buy the independently cleared, liquid token only after relative-strength confirmation; hedge with an authorized broad instrument if specified. Evaluate only information available at decision time; attempt execution afterward. Exit: Exit on operational relapse or relative-strength failure. Always apply the earlier of the registered maximum holding time and hard risk invalidation; fills can be delayed or unavailable. Parameters to pre-register: eligible universe and point-in-time membership, observation window and completed-event/bar rule, numerical threshold(s) named by the signal, entry order and maximum price/quote deviation, initial invalidation level and target if used, H_max and explicit session definition, cost, impact, latency, failed-attempt, and leg-risk models, position/notional/exit-capacity caps, baseline and out-of-sample rejection thresholds.
blocked_reason: needs operational status feeds (transfers, routers, pools) with timestamps
